list.label: Instance
list.description: Scrape targets to include. Counters sum across the selection; the shared-state gauges (read from the one Postgres, so every instance reports the same value) take the max instead.

panels.title: Clicks per service (rate)
panels.description: Per-instance counter: each instance counts only the clicks it served, so summing across the selected instances is the fleet total.

panels.title: Clicks per service and role (total)
panels.description: Per-instance counter: each instance counts only the clicks it served, so summing across the selected instances is the fleet total.

panels.title: HTTP request latency p95 (by route)
panels.description: Per-instance histogram: each instance observes only its own requests, so the buckets sum across the selected instances before the quantile is taken.

panels.title: Active sessions
panels.description: Shared-state gauge: read from the one Postgres on every instance's refresh, so every instance reports the same value. Aggregated with max, not sum — summing would multiply the real number by the instance count.
